chunks: "We shall ignore you today," they will be told, "as you had forgotten the meeting of this Day. Your dwelling place is Hell, and there is none to save you."
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He will 'forget' those who forgot the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the principle of *muqabala* (reciprocal treatment), where Allah's 'forgetting' signifies the withholding of mercy and acceptance of deeds as a direct consequence of the believers' neglect of the Hereafter during their worldly life. The mention of 'no helper' (*min nasirin*) underscores the absolute isolation of the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection, contrasting with the intercession granted to the faithful through the Ahl al-Bayt. This serves as a stern warning against the spiritual complacency that leads to eternal abode in the Fire.
